# Published targets (transcribed, do not edit)

- `duarte2016_table1.csv`: Duarte et al. 2016, *Methods Ecol. Evol.*, Table 1
  (mu_tol = 10, 1000 analyses per cell). `stat` = mean Mantel rho or mean ADONIS R2;
  "<0.001" transcribed as 0.001. p_max = "Largest P-value" column.
- `pnk2015_table1.csv`: Peres-Neto & Kembel 2015, *Plant Ecol.*, Table 1, PCC rows
  (row/col = p_max, row = p_site, col = p_taxa).
